_about: Template: how a lab's EDF markers become speller-link messages. Fill it from one real file: run `python stimulus_kit/tools/eeg_source.py info file.edf`, then put the codes below. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_keyboard: symbols and layout must match what the participant saw in this recording; len(symbols) = rows × cols
_epoch: fnmatch patterns (* and ?) of markers that start/end one symbol. Leave empty if the epoch number is inside the flash label (epoch_group) or if there are no such markers (then all flashes form one epoch; split with --start/--stop)
_flash: regex rules, the first match wins. Symbols: symbols (fixed list), row_from_group / col_from_group / symbol_from_group (index from a regex group; offset = number of the first one), symbols_from_group (letters in the label, sep = separator). Optional epoch_group: regex group with the epoch number
_cue: marker with the target letter (copy-spelling); group 1 is the letter. Goes to SpellerReplayMarkers only (the contract does not send targets); kept for calibration labels. Delete if targets are in a separate log
